import pandas as pd

# Read the source CSV file with index_col=0 to ignore the numerical index column
source_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length1_29/training_0.csv"
df = pd.read_csv(source_path, index_col=0)

# Group by 'Gender' and count the number of 'Purchase ID' entries per gender
result = df.groupby('Gender', as_index=False)['Purchase ID'].count()

# Rename the count column to '0' as per target schema
result.rename(columns={'Purchase ID': '0'}, inplace=True)

# Ensure the 'Gender' column is string type and '0' column is integer type
result['Gender'] = result['Gender'].astype(str)
result['0'] = result['0'].astype(int)

# Write the result to the target CSV file without the index
target_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_29/target_multisource.csv"
result.to_csv(target_path, index=False)
